WITH RECURSIVE child_nodes AS ( SELECT
FROM base_organization_info boi WHERE id = #{id} UNION SELECT boi2.id, boi2.parent_id, boi2."name", boi2.levels, boi2.add_user, boi2.add_time, boi2.update_user, boi2.update_time, boi2."type", boi2.unify_encoding, boi2.description, boi2.company_nature, boi2.business_registration_number, boi2.legal_person_name, boi2.legal_representative_phone_number, boi2.province, boi2.province_name, boi2.city, boi2.city_name, boi2.warehouse_nature, boi2.design_storage, boi2.design_area, boi2.library_area_code, boi2.contact_person, boi2.contact_phone, boi2.detailed_address FROM base_organization_info boi2 JOIN child_nodes pn ON pn.id = boi2.parent_id ) SELECT *, boi2.name as parent_name FROM child_nodes cn left join base_organization_info boi2 on cn.parent_id = boi2.id;

WITH RECURSIVE parent_nodes AS ( SELECT

WITH RECURSIVE child_nodes AS ( SELECT
FROM base_organization_info boi WHERE id = #{id} UNION SELECT boi2.id, boi2.parent_id, boi2."name", boi2.levels, boi2.add_user, boi2.add_time, boi2.update_user, boi2.update_time, boi2."type", boi2.unify_encoding, boi2.description, boi2.company_nature, boi2.business_registration_number, boi2.legal_person_name, boi2.legal_representative_phone_number, boi2.province, boi2.province_name, boi2.city, boi2.city_name, boi2.warehouse_nature, boi2.design_storage, boi2.design_area, boi2.library_area_code, boi2.contact_person, boi2.contact_phone, boi2.detailed_address FROM base_organization_info boi2 JOIN child_nodes pn ON pn.id = boi2.parent_id ) SELECT *, boi2.name as parent_name FROM child_nodes cn left join base_organization_info boi2 on cn.parent_id = boi2.id where cn.levels = #{levels};
